info.description:
Backend API for a multi-tenant (SaaS) ophthalmology clinic
management system: patients, visits, billing/POS, inventory,
lab jobs, reports, and optical calculators.

Every route under /api (other than /api/auth/*, /api/signup,
and the /api/auth/password-reset|email endpoints) requires a
Bearer access token, and most additionally require the
caller's clinic to have an active subscription.
info.title: Opthalmic Management System API

post.description: Marks the token's owning user's email as verified.
Sends a fresh verification code (valid 24h) to the authenticated caller's own email address, invalidating any previously issued one.
Exchanges email + password for an access token (short-lived JWT) and a refresh token (long-lived, rotating).

Revokes the session backing the given refresh token. The already-issued access token keeps working until it expires (at most TOKEN_DURATION) — access tokens are stateless and not checked against sessions on every request.
Applies a new password using the code from RequestPasswordReset, then revokes every existing session for that user (forcing re-login everywhere).

Always returns the same success response regardless of whether the email belongs to an account, so this endpoint can't be used to enumerate registered emails. If it does, a single-use code valid for 1 hour is emailed.

Exchanges a valid, not-yet-used refresh token for a new access+refresh pair, rotating the old one. Presenting an already-rotated-out refresh token is treated as theft and revokes every session for that user.
